information: ### **Note: This competition does not feature the 3x3x3 Cube event.** Welcome to Please Be Quiet Kuala Lumpur 2025! This will be a small competition featuring only blindfolded events. For those who are interested in joining **Malaysia FMC Championship 2025** can register through [here](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/Competition/Info/PleaseBeQuietKualaLumpur2025). The event will take place at the same venue immediately after the end of this competition. ​ [![Malaysia Cube Association(MYCSA)](https://imgur.com/ZUv6wZJ.jpg)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/Competition/Info/PleaseBeQuietKualaLumpur2025)
